create.name: Erin Treat
create.bio:
Erin Treat is a Buddhist meditation teacher in the Insight tradition who has practised for around thirty years. Since 2013 she has guided the teaching at Vallecitos, a wilderness retreat centre in the mountains of northern New Mexico, and for two decades she was among the leaders of the Durango Dharma Center's teaching council in Colorado. She sits on the Spirit Rock teachers' council and leads retreats there and at the Insight Meditation Society, and she has long studied the Diamond Approach of A. H. Almaas.

The land is central to how she teaches. Many of her retreats at Vallecitos take place in silence among forest and meadow, with nature treated as a teacher in its own right, and she pairs this with care for both personal and collective freedom. Her 2027 programme includes Land as Dharma Teacher with Brian Lesage, a retreat combining sitting practice and music with the singer Jennifer Berezan, and The Quiet Advantage, a five-day silent retreat for people carrying heavy responsibility at work, taught with Gullu Singh and Rolf Gates. Recordings of her talks are freely available through Dharma Seed. She lives in Durango, Colorado.

courses.title: The Quiet Advantage: A Silent Retreat for Leaders
courses.description: A five-day silent retreat at Vallecitos for executives, founders and others with heavy responsibilities, limited to 24 people and joined by application. Days combine sitting and walking practice, mindful movement, time on the land and one-to-one meetings with the teachers; no experience is needed.

courses.title: Land as Dharma Teacher (Vallecitos 2027)
courses.description: A week-long silent retreat in the New Mexico mountains, taught with Brian Lesage, that treats the forest and the land itself as a source of teaching. It runs twice in 2027, in early July and early August; the centre's 2027 schedule also lists her retreat of meditation and music with Jennifer Berezan.

free_resources.title: Erin Treat's talks at Vallecitos (Dharma Seed)
free_resources.description: Her recorded Dharma talks and guided sittings from retreats at Vallecitos, free to stream or download on Dharma Seed.
